name: awesome-gbadev
desc: A curated list of Game Boy Advance development resources

resources.name: GBAdev Forum
resources.desc: Our new hub for announcements and long-form discussion. It's a good place to ask questions and share progress on your projects.

resources.name: GBAdev Discord / IRC
resources.desc: This is where everyone hangs out to chat nowadays. Come say hi!

resources.name: GBAdev.org
resources.desc: The longstanding homepage of the scene. Still updated with news and releases (but the forums have been broken for a while).

resources.name: GBAtemp
resources.desc: The site carries the GBA name, but nowadays the console is relegated to the backbenches. It's a good place to talk about gaming and hardware though.

resources.name: GBATEK
resources.desc: Programming specs for the GBA and NDS hardware

resources.name: CowBite Virtual Hardware Specifications
resources.desc: Older GBA hardware documentation

resources.name: The Audio Advance
resources.desc: Audio hardware documentation and basic test ROMs

resources.name: Tonc
resources.desc: The new, revamped version of the GBA programming tutorial. The original version is here.

resources.name: Compile C++ for GBA in under an hour
resources.desc: Cinemint's video for getting started with C++/Butano

resources.name: Sound on the Gameboy Advance
resources.desc: How to write your own sound mixer / MOD music player

resources.name: Larold's Retro Gameyard - Game Boy Advance Tutorials
resources.desc: Learn how to make GBA games using the Butano Game Engine. Each part of the engine will have own individual tutorial with example source code.

resources.name: Gameboy Advance Resource Management
resources.desc: Allocation techniques for the GBA's various memory regions

resources.name: Managing Sprite Cel VRAM on the Game Boy Advance
resources.desc: Analysis of the VRAM streaming approach for animated sprites

resources.name: Using Beepbox for GBA Music Composition
devkitARM
resources.desc: C/C++ cross-compiler toolchain, which includes libgba, libtonc, maxmod, and various tools and example projects.

resources.name: gba-toolchain
resources.desc: GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain based alternative to devkitARM.

resources.name: gvasm
resources.desc: Stand-alone assembler and disassembler (WIP) designed specifically for GBA homebrew

resources.name: TinyGo
resources.desc: An alternative Go compiler for embedded systems, that supports GBA compilation

resources.name: rust-console
resources.desc: GBA programming in Rust, plus tutorial.

resources.name: natu
resources.desc: GBA programming in Nim (provides wrapper around libtonc, maxmod and more).

resources.name: gba-modern
resources.desc: Write GBA games using modern C++.

resources.name: ZigGBA
resources.desc: WIP SDK for creating GBA games using Zig (Inspired by Tonc).

resources.name: Butano
resources.desc: Modern C++ high level engine for the GBA.

resources.name: BPCore Engine
resources.desc: Create GBA applications with the Lua programming language

resources.name: GBA Dlang
resources.desc: WIP SDK for GBA development using D, using LLVM toolchain. provides fully functional TONC, GBFS, Maxmod.

resources.name: dusk
resources.desc: Simple, lightweight, intuitive framework for GBA game development

resources.name: gbsenpai
resources.desc: GB Studio player GBA port with some enhancements.

resources.name: meson-gba
resources.desc: Meson-based GBA toolkit with support for many different libraries and tools.

resources.name: sdk-seven
resources.desc: Modern runtime and tooling, and libraries for GBA development. Works with meson-gba or standalone.

resources.name: rath
resources.desc: Forth programming environment for the Game Boy Advance

resources.name: ada-gba-dev
resources.desc: A build system, libraries, and tools for producing programs for the Game Boy Advance using the Ada programming language.

resources.name: agb
resources.desc: Rust high level framework for the GBA with a build system, asset importing, tracker player and graphics abstractions.

resources.name: agbabi
resources.desc: Drop-in application binary interface library (context switching, division, irq, memcpy, sine).

resources.name: gba-hpp
resources.desc: C++20 header-only library for GBA development.

resources.name: HeartLib
resources.desc: Comprehensive C library inspired by the classic HAMLib.

resources.name: libseven
resources.desc: Modern, from-scratch replacement for libgba and libtonc.

resources.name: GBAdv
resources.desc: High level utilities on top of libgba.

resources.name: Maxmod
resources.desc: Music and sound library (supports .mod, .xm, .s3m, .it)

resources.name: Apex Audio System
resources.desc: Music and sound library (supports .mod only, but _very_ good performance)

resources.name: Krawall
resources.desc: Music and sound library (supports .xm, .s3m)

resources.name: Pimpmobile
resources.desc: Music library (supports .mod, .xm)

resources.name: GBT Player
resources.desc: Music library that uses the DMG sound channels (close to 0% CPU usage).

resources.name: posprintf
resources.desc: An sprintf routine written in Thumb assembler.

resources.name: GBFS
resources.desc: Practical filesystem

resources.name: gbaLib
resources.desc: Library for programming the GBA with TinyGo

resources.name: gba-link-connection
resources.desc: A set of C++ libraries to interact with the Serial Port (Link Cable, Wireless Adapter, GPIO, SPI)

resources.name: mGBA
resources.desc: Actively developed GBA emulator. Runs on a bunch of platforms. Text debugger through GDB stub.

resources.name: No$gba
resources.desc: Venerable GBA emulator. Windows only, but runs well under Wine. Not very actively maintained but still gets updates now and then. Sports graphical debugger.

resources.name: NanoBoyAdvance
resources.desc: GBA emulator with high accuracy, especially in timing and CPU emulation. Does not have debugging features.

resources.name: Mesen
resources.desc: Multi-system emulator with high GBA accuracy. It provides great built-in GUI tools such as a debugger, a profiler and an event viewer.

resources.name: SkyEmu
resources.desc: GB/GBA/NDS Emulator with built in debuggers, REST API for scripting, and high accuracy.

resources.name: MiSTer FPGA implementation
resources.desc: Needs MiSTer setup to run.

resources.name: 240p-test-mini
resources.desc: video signal tests

resources.name: Goodboy Advance
resources.desc: Made in 2018, and has a nice bit of information on how it's made.

resources.name: Celeste Classic
resources.desc: 2019 port of Pico8 version of Celeste.

resources.name: GBADoom
resources.desc: 2019/2020 GBA port of prBoom version of Doom.

resources.name: BlindJump
resources.desc: Adventure game, developed in 2020. Implementation of link-cable multiplayer, fully digital audio.

resources.name: Tigermoth
resources.desc: Bullet hell game, developed for the GBAJam 2021

resources.name: Duster
resources.desc: A sleek strategy board game for the gba

resources.name: OpenLara
resources.desc: Classic Tomb Raider open-source engine

resources.name: gba_bios
resources.desc: WIP disassembly of the Game Boy Advance BIOS

resources.name: GBA bare metal code
resources.desc: Various experiments by Krom, such as video playback and 3D, written in ARM Assembly

resources.name: dkarm_gba_docker
resources.desc: A Docker image that includes DevkitARM and other GBA SDK tools, packaged together to allow a consistent toolchain configuration and reproducibility in builds. Also can be helpful in ensuring a consistent build environment for continuous integration.

resources.name: Usenti
resources.desc: Simple bitmap editor for paletted images aimed at GBA development.

resources.name: RGB55 colour picker
resources.desc: Tool for picking colours in the BGR555 colour format the GBA uses.

resources.name: Reverse Engineering a GameBoy Advance Game
resources.desc: A series of detailed posts and talks about developing a level editor for *Klonoa: Empire of Dreams*

resources.name: Pokemon Ruby
resources.desc: C programming language annotation of a Pokemon Ruby disassembly

resources.name: HEL
resources.desc: GBA C library built on top of HAM (a classic SDK from back in the day)
